answer: One defense is similarity clustering: every answer is embedded, and accounts whose outputs keep landing in the same tight nebula of meaning are flagged, their rewards frozen pending review. An attacker running fifty puppets must then pay for fifty truly distinct lines of reasoning, so each fake costs nearly as much compute as an honest agent, and the copper-penny margin that made a sybil farm pay shrinks to nothing. Rewards flow through a narrow inlet only unflagged accounts reach.
